runtime-artifact envelope should be attempt-native by default
`artifact_id` is canonical identity of renderable artifact object itself
`logical_artifact_id` and `linked_artifact_id` are lineage/navigation helpers, not replacements for runtime identity
`attempt_id` should be present whenever artifact came from concrete execution attempt
if no concrete attempt, envelope should carry strongest available runtime anchor: `thread_id` for thread-only artifacts, wizard/report identity for upstream planning artifacts
`cost_usage` must carry `usage_event_ref` whenever available and should carry `attempt_id?`, `provider_attempt_ref?` when traceable
`evidence`, `validation_test`, `failed_attempts`, `before_after_snapshot` should be attempt-native whenever produced by node worker/verifier/reviewer flow
receipt-like artifacts should carry external linkage refs but anchor locally on `attempt_id`
notes: Missing piece is no longer schemas; it is common envelope contract is underspecified
`artifact_id` should identify the artifact object, not the runtime attempt
Runtime-artifact and project-artifact families staying distinct but need parallel discipline about canonical vs derived identity

seed_items.canon_label_hint: FileManager open-by-identity contract split
exact_items: keep `OpenFile { path: PathBuf, line?, range?, target_group? }` for canonical workspace-file opens
add second canonical open contract for identity-native objects: `OpenSubject { subject_id, target_group?, open_mode?, location? }`

`OpenSubject` identity families: `doc:<document_id>` resolves to workspace file/buffer, `artifact:<artifact_id>` resolves to backing document or transient `generated://<artifact_id>` buffer, `attempt:<attempt_id>`, `safe_point:<safe_point_id>`, `remediation:<remediation_root_id>`, `scheduler_pass:<scheduler_pass_id>` resolve through projections/indexes

path-based open remains for repo/workspace files; identity-based open is canonical entrypoint for runtime artifacts, generated drafts, attempt/evidence/safe-point/remediation reports, preview/document hybrids
UI callers should not reconstruct file paths heuristically when stable identity exists

resolution order: resolve subject type, if file-backed canonical document exists open/focus workspace buffer, else if artifact-backed content exists open transient or specialized viewer, else if best target is another surface route to that surface with exact identity context, if no valid target fail explicitly with typed open error
heading_hints: Recommended resolution order for identity opens
notes: Real seam is workspace document open vs subject/identity open, not path vs not path
`generated://<artifact_id>` already proof system needs non-path editor targets
Seam tightly connected to routing/deep-link normalization

seed_items.canon_label_hint: routing/deep-link normalization with OpenSubject
exact_items: define one canonical internal route/target payload for navigation
`resume_url` should be one serialized transport form of that payload
command palette, search, artifact deep-links, blocked notices, FileManager/Editor opens should resolve through same internal target model
path-based target: `open_file` uses `OpenFile { path, line?, range?, target_group? }`
identity-based target: `open_subject` uses `OpenSubject { subject_id, target_group?, open_mode?, location? }`

surface-focus target: route to specific page/tab/inspector with context (Usage with `usage_event_ref`, Ledger with event identity, Orchestrator with `focused_run_id`/node/attempt/tab/inspector, wizard resume via `wizard_id + step`)
notes: System needs routing contract, not just more command IDs
`resume_url` should not stay most expressive navigation mechanism
Clean model is one navigation payload with multiple target kinds

seed_items.canon_label_hint: command-catalog navigation/open family addition
exact_items: add canonical navigation/open command family: `cmd.nav.open_subject`, `cmd.nav.open_usage_subject`, `cmd.nav.focus_route`, or equivalent compact family
`cmd.nav.open_subject` args should carry normalized subject/route target, resolves file/document/artifact/generated/report targets
`cmd.nav.focus_route` restores page/tab/run/thread/inspector context without implying editing/opening
`cmd.nav.open_usage_subject` resolves canonical Usage/Ledger identity from `usage_event_ref` or equivalent
domain-specific 'open in X' commands can still exist where they express meaningful product action but should be wrappers over same route/subject model

navigation commands should carry: `subject_id?`, `target_kind?`, `route_payload?`, `project_id?`, `focused_run_id?`, `thread_id?`, `tab_id?`, `inspector_target?`, `line?` / `range?` for file-backed opens
notes: Reduces command sprawl and gives wiring/tests reusable navigation primitives
Keeps artifact/report/usage/deep-link routing aligned instead of drifting per surface
Catalog gap is structural, not just missing IDs
